Intermediaries shall at all times maintain the electronic records relating to such forms for a minimum period of three years."

tijori.business_description: Advit Jewels Ltd is a Jaipur-based manufacturer of handcrafted fine jewellery, specializing in Kundan, Polki, diamond and studded designs under the legacy “Rambhajo” brand. The company serves both B2B and B2C markets through in-house manufacturing and customized offerings.
